author: Inside Edition
description: Law enforcement officers from the Albuquerque Police Department in New Mexico say they had to break a car's windows to save twin 20-month-old boys left alone for hours outside a bar. The rescue was caught on officer body camera. When the children's father showed up, his excuse was that so many people wanted to dance with him, he couldn't leave, according to the police report. He was arrested, and now faces child abuse charges. Inside Edition's Jim Moret has the details.
title: Cops Break Window To Rescue Twin Toddlers Left In Car While Dad Was At Bar

author: Inside Edition
description: A tourist named Ken Nurse is thankful to be alive after a visit to Montana's majestic Glacier National Park. He was trying to get the perfect vacation photo when he fell 120 feet down a waterfall. "I stepped out on an area that looked very clear to me, and the ground gave out on me," he said. He was airlifted to safety, and thankfully survived the ordeal. Inside Edition's Alison Hall spoke to Nurse and the people who helped save him. To contribute to Nurse's medical expenses, please visit: https://www.supportnow.org/the-nurse-family
title: Tourist Posing For Photo Nearly Dies At Glacier National Park Waterfall

author: Inside Edition
description: There was more drama at the Lindsay Clancy murder trial in Massachusetts today. The jury was back in the courtroom, but did not have a verdict. They have been sent back to deliberate after they told the court they are deadlocked, unable to make a unanimous decision on whether Clancy was suffering from postpartum psychosis when she strangled her three children in 2023. If convicted, Clancy faces life behind bars. Inside Edition's Ann Mercogliano is at the courthouse with the latest.
title: Lindsay Clancy Jury Is Deadlocked

author: Inside Edition
description: Winnie-the-Pooh is famous for loving their honey but one man in the Catskills region of New York might have found a bear that rivals the timeless cartoon. Michael Gross filmed a bear who was determined to get a snack in his yard as it stumbled upon a beehive and didn’t mind getting continuously stung as it hunted for food by digging a hole in the ground.
title: A Swarm Of Bees Could Not Stop This Bear From Getting A Snack

author: Inside Edition
description: After nearly 30 years, the man prosecutors say is responsible for the death of rapper Tupac Shakur has been found guilty. Duane “Keffe D” Davis was found guilty of first-degree murder Monday in a Nevada courtroom in the 1996 death of the rapper, which has remained unsolved for nearly three decades. Davis will be sentenced next month. Tupac Shakur died nearly a week after the shooting on September 13, 1996. He was just 25 years old. He is considered one of the greatest rappers of all time and has sold over 75 million records worldwide.
title: Keefe D Found Guilty in Orchestrating Tupac Shakur's 1996 Murder
